Now is not the time to worry about holding a 10% better remote standup. It is time to care for fellow humans. To connect.

Any adding "efficiency" you get in the next 4-8w, or goals you hit, will be overwhelmingly offset by the how you show up for the humans you work with.

Tip for people going remote for the first time

1 remote hr = 2.5 in-office hours.
